picture.alt: Three students sit together at a wooden table in front of large windows. Outside the windows are green mountains, a curving bay of blue sea with a sandy beach, some city buildings, trees and a blue sky with white clouds. On the left, a girl with short wavy dark-brown hair and round glasses wears a white collared shirt under a dark purple knit vest; she holds a light-purple phone in one hand, points at its screen with the other and is talking. In the middle, a boy with black hair wears an open green jacket over a red striped T-shirt; he rests his cheek on his hand and smiles. On the right, a girl with long curly dark-brown hair and gold hoop earrings wears an open blue shirt over an orange top and white trousers; she rests her chin on her hand and smiles. On the table: a stack of blue and green books, an open spiral notebook with a green pen lying on it, a postcard of a sea-and-mountain view like the one outside, a lavender water bottle and a black backpack. A white backpack hangs on the chair behind the girl with glasses. Nothing hangs on the windows, and nobody is holding the postcard.

text.traditional: 我在台北住了三年了。剛來的時候，我住在學校附近，房租一個月只要六千塊。可是這裡的房租越來越貴，現在要九千了。我的獎學金不多，快要住不起了，所以下個學期我打算搬到郊區去。那裡的房租比較便宜，坐捷運到學校也只要半個小時。
text.simplified: 我在台北住了三年了。刚来的时候，我住在学校附近，房租一个月只要六千块。可是这里的房租越来越贵，现在要九千了。我的奖学金不多，快要住不起了，所以下个学期我打算搬到郊区去。那里的房租比较便宜，坐捷运到学校也只要半个小时。
text.pinyin: Wǒ zài Táiběi zhù le sān nián le. Gāng lái de shíhòu, wǒ zhù zài xuéxiào fùjìn, fángzū yí ge yuè zhǐ yào liùqiān kuài. Kěshì zhèlǐ de fángzū yuè lái yuè guì, xiànzài yào jiǔqiān le. Wǒ de jiǎngxuéjīn bù duō, kuài yào zhù bù qǐ le, suǒyǐ xià ge xuéqí wǒ dǎsuàn bān dào jiāoqū qù. Nàlǐ de fángzū bǐjiào piányí, zuò jiéyùn dào xuéxiào yě zhǐ yào bàn ge xiǎoshí.
text.english: I've lived in Taipei for three years. When I first came, I lived near the school, and the rent was only six thousand a month. But rents here keep going up; now it's nine thousand. My scholarship isn't much, and soon I won't be able to afford it, so next semester I plan to move to the suburbs. Rent there is cheaper, and it's only half an hour to school by MRT.

prompt.traditional: 下面哪一個是對的？
prompt.simplified: 下面哪一个是对的？
prompt.pinyin: Xiàmiàn nǎ yí ge shì duì de?
prompt.english: Which of the following is true?

choices.english: The writer used to live in the suburbs.

choices.pinyin: Tā yǐjīng bān dào jiāoqū le.
choices.english: The writer has already moved to the suburbs.

choices.traditional: 他現在的房租比以前貴
choices.simplified: 他现在的房租比以前贵
choices.pinyin: Tā xiànzài de fángzū bǐ yǐqián guì.
choices.english: The writer's rent is higher now than before.

choices.traditional: 他坐捷運到學校要一個小時
choices.simplified: 他坐捷运到学校要一个小时
choices.pinyin: Tā zuò jiéyùn dào xuéxiào yào yí ge xiǎoshí.
choices.english: The MRT ride to school takes the writer an hour.

questions.why: 房租越來越貴: the rent went from 6,000 to 9,000. The writer used to live near the school, moves to the suburbs only next semester, and from there the MRT takes half an hour.

text.traditional: 上星期是我媽媽的生日。我在台灣念書，不能回家，所以寄給她一張卡片和一些台灣的名產。媽媽收到以後，馬上打電話給我，說她很開心。我們聊了一個多小時，我覺得好像回到了家一樣。
text.simplified: 上星期是我妈妈的生日。我在台湾念书，不能回家，所以寄给她一张卡片和一些台湾的名产。妈妈收到以后，马上打电话给我，说她很开心。我们聊了一个多小时，我觉得好像回到了家一样。
text.pinyin: Shàng xīngqí shì wǒ māma de shēngrì. Wǒ zài Táiwān niànshū, bù néng huíjiā, suǒyǐ jì gěi tā yì zhāng kǎpiàn hé yìxiē Táiwān de míngchǎn. Māma shōudào yǐhòu, mǎshàng dǎ diànhuà gěi wǒ, shuō tā hěn kāixīn. Wǒmen liáo le yí ge duō xiǎoshí, wǒ juéde hǎoxiàng huídào le jiā yíyàng.
text.english: Last week was my mom's birthday. I'm studying in Taiwan and couldn't go home, so I mailed her a card and some Taiwanese specialties. As soon as she got them, she called me and said she was very happy. We talked for over an hour, and it felt as if I were back home.

prompt.traditional: 媽媽生日的時候，這個人做了什麼？
prompt.simplified: 妈妈生日的时候，这个人做了什么？
prompt.pinyin: Māma shēngrì de shíhòu, zhège rén zuò le shénme?
prompt.english: What did the writer do for Mom's birthday?

choices.english: The writer mailed Mom some things.
The writer went home to celebrate with Mom.
The writer called Mom.

choices.pinyin: Tā shōudào le māma de kǎpiàn.
choices.english: The writer got a card from Mom.

questions.why: 寄給她……: the writer mailed things to Mom. Mom called the writer (打電話給我), not the other way round, and the writer couldn't go home.
